status_basis: Conversation decisions; source comparison; historical model-extraction evidence; package-layout numeric/AST checks, wheel import verification, and full suite rerun in both staging and the applied worktree. Revision 03 reorganizes the document only; it does not rerun or supersede the recorded numerical checks. Revision 04 separates document scope from tool development goals and initial support scope; it changes documentation only. Revision 05 extends the system workflow through results, observables, visualization and storage, and describes block responsibilities. The diagram is a target architecture; existing implementation foundations and future extensions are distinguished. No code or detailed API contract changes. Revision 06 splits the workflow diagram into input preparation and calculation/result use, followed by the existing responsibility table. It changes slide layout and explanatory wording only. Revision 07 aligns the geometry block directly below system construction and clarifies the classical spin configuration as a separate initial configuration for optimization or reference configuration for LSWT. No API or implementation changes. Revision 08 clarifies the computational spin system as the model instantiated with calculation geometry and names the classical state inputs as spin directions and magnetic-structure periodicity. Documentation terminology only. Revision 09 records the 1st development scope and contract decisions made with the user on 2026-09-29: model as Hamiltonian, external-variable classes, state-geometry commensurability, terms[] schema with bilinear and zeeman kinds, g-tensor with external B and -mu_B sign, square/triangular Heisenberg benchmarks with a minimal ED verification tool, spintoolkit package target, and Kitaev as a later benchmark. The detailed contract Markdown was updated first; details not decided by the user are marked as proposals. No code or numerical evidence changes. Revision 10 records the user's decisions on the four detail proposals: optional zeeman terms with a warning when B is nonzero and a site has none, the g_(alpha beta) index convention, mu_B = 1 for relative energy units, and a split between state validation and reference-state diagnostics (stationarity, Colpa stability). No code or numerical evidence changes. Revision 11 records the user's decisions on open items: the standard Fourier sign with the full-position gauge as a toolkit convention (theory canon status unchanged), the resulting NBCP displacement reading r_target = r_source - d with a conversion rule to be confirmed numerically in stage 2 by elementwise H(k) comparison, the split of state/request/result into common and method-specific parts with SpinState, common request, result header and LSWT body drafts, and spintoolkit/models/ for standard benchmarks. The displacement coverage check was rerun on the current code; no code or numerical evidence changes. Revision 12 is a cleanup: the contract was split into the transfer contract and the 1st development plan (content preserved, decisions tagged D01-D15), the decided detail-rules page moved to appendix B, the two displacement pages were merged, and an unused macro was removed. No content, code or numerical evidence changes. Revision 13 records stage 0: the package rename lswt -> spintoolkit (methods/spin_wave -> methods/lswt) with a code-space/lswt compatibility package, verified against baseline commit 49f047a by per-test-ID pytest comparison, a 208-value numerical snapshot (maximum difference 0), compatibility tests, an offline wheel build and an editable reinstall. Source paths in this manifest now point to code-space/spintoolkit. Revision 14 records stage 1: SpinModel, SpinState, ExternalConditions, CalculationGeometry with validation, a classical energy/field/torque consumer and the Heisenberg benchmarks (D16), verified by exact classical energies, finite-difference fields, an NBCP cross-check against the existing EnergyFunction, 53 new tests, unchanged outcomes for the 225 existing tests and the 208-value snapshot. Revision 15 records the fix of the quantum path of SpinOptimizer.find_minimum (commit d43d8d4: DE fallback with E_cl + E_qm comparison, no in-place mutation of the DE angles; 225 passed / same 5 failed, 208-value snapshot difference 0), a concise description of the current classical/MAGSWT/quantum search paths, and the user's decision D17: zero-point state selection only on the classical ground-state manifold, along the orbit R_n(phi) whose axis is fixed by the classical Hessian null space, with an E_cl constancy check. The axis rule was checked numerically on the NBCP Y state (examples/nbcp_y_orbit_axis_check.py). The contract Markdown was updated first. D17 is not implemented. Merged after stage 1 (revision 14), so the state-selection decision is numbered D17; after the merge 278 passed / same 5 failed and the 208-value snapshot difference is 0. Revision 16 records the angle_setting=None fix (commit 8f4dd1e; 280 passed / same 5 failed, snapshot difference 0), numbers for the open D17 criteria from examples/nbcp_y_orbit_criteria_check.py (null-space rules on 18 DE runs: fixed tolerance 8/12, gap ratio 12/12, polish then fixed tolerance 12/12, no false positives; sixfold E_qm amplitude within 1.1% of the converged lambda_6 at N=6 and minimum at phi = 0 mod pi/3 for all N >= 3) with review proposals that are not decisions, and a correction: the J_Gamma = 0.010 spread is a converged selection, not an unreliable one. Revision 17 records D18 (D17 implementation plan: remove the unconstrained E_cl+E_qm 'quantum' path with the D17 implementation and warn until then, keep MAGSWT pending a reproduction check, place D17 as stage 2b, limit the triangular benchmark to h = 0 and h > h_sat) and D19 (selectable physical or fixed-constant criteria with defaults in definitions/defaults.py). Revision 18 records D20: dimensionless numerics in the coefficient energy unit E0 (field = mu_B B / E0, temperature = k_B T / E0), Units and unit conversion removed; physical units T, K, meV are a documented convention converted by the user. Revision 19 records stage 2 (D21): NBCP common model with published parameter sets and candidate states, SpinSystem conversion in both directions, and D13 confirmed by element-wise H(k) agreement (1.7e-16) with the legacy builders. Revision 20 records stage 2b (D22): zero-point state selection on the classical manifold (methods/state_selection.select_on_manifold) with an analytic tangent-space Hessian and classical refinement (methods/classical), the D19 physics-mode coefficients chosen at implementation (for user review), and removal of the unconstrained 'quantum' optimizer. NBCP Y (0.2 T) and V (1.4 T) with J_PD or J_Gamma = 0.010 meV are selected in both modes at N = 6 and 12 with harmonic amplitudes and curvatures within 1.1% (N = 6) and 0.2% (N = 12) of independent N = 48 scans; the 1.64e-12 J_Gamma Y-state splitting is resolved about 900 times above the fit threshold. DE starts, controls, triangular 120-degree and square polarized benchmarks and the MAGSWT reproduction are recorded; 373 passed / same 5 failed, 208-value snapshot difference 0. Revision 21 records stage 3 (D23): finite-torus expansion with rules shared by all methods (duplicated bonds summed, bonds folding onto one site rejected in classical, ED and LSWT comparisons), a general exact-diagonalization tool with optional U(1) magnetization and translation-momentum sectors, one-magnon ED equal to the LSWT bands at every torus momentum within 1.6e-14 in nine cases including DM (the -k pairing fails, fixing the momentum sign), symmetry-free spectra equal to an independent Kronecker construction within 4.6e-14, and the 4x4 square S = 1/2 ground state -0.7017802 per site; 404 passed / same 5 failed, 208-value snapshot difference 0. Revision 22 records stage 4a (D24): solve_lswt on the common model types with the common result header and JSON output, default regularization 'none' with zero modes reported (an exact Goldstone mode made positive by round-off is caught by a relative tolerance), diagonalization data kept for reuse, exact reproduction of LSWTSolver on NBCP, convergence to the analytic square and triangular LSWT values, and approximate comparisons with QMC and DMRG; 421 passed / same 5 failed, 208-value snapshot difference 0. Revision 23 records stage 4b (D25): zero-mode scan in three classes from lambda_min(H)/scale with a user decision step for candidates, Goldstone/accidental/line zero modes distinguished, dimensionless finite-temperature F, U, S, C and moments reusing the stored diagonalization, and agreement with ED below exp(-2 Delta/t) at low temperature; 437 passed / same 5 failed, 208-value snapshot difference 0. Revision 24 records stage 4c (D26): mode-resolved one-magnon structure factor and exact Bragg intensities equal to ED matrix elements within 1e-15, Neel analytic weights, sum rules on the extended mesh, bond correlations reproducing E_GS, and the diagnosis of the existing correlations module (per-cell normalization and a doubled sublattice phase); 452 passed / same 5 failed, 208-value snapshot difference 0. Revision 25 records the cleanup of existing code (D27): the MAGSWT grid search and the unverified observables/correlations.py are removed; orbit_energy_landscape, spin_correlation and to_ladder replace them; the NBCP examples use the classical search followed by select_on_manifold; 457 passed / same 5 failed, the 144 remaining snapshot values unchanged (64 leaves of the removed MAGSWT searches reported as not compared). Revision 26 adds the review proposal D28 (not a decision): the classical-quantum comparison by the one-loop effective potential on the relaxed soft path, with its check (D17 limit reproduced, the rigid orbit overestimates classical pinning by a factor 14 for Y at 1.7 degrees, correcting the provisional statement). No code change. Revision 27 records the adoption of the D28 principle (one-loop effective potential on the relaxed soft path); details and implementation pending. No code change. Revision 28 records the D28 details (Gamma minimum returned, descriptive verdicts, adiabatic warning at 0.1) and the confirmation of the D19 resolution coefficients; the implementation waits for the resumption of LSWT work. No code change. Revision 29 fixes the five CommensurateStructure tests (angle count inconsistent with the diagonal supercell; the class is unchanged): 120-degree order is checked with a 3-site basis and a 3x3 supercell, and a 3x1 cell is shown not to hold it. It adds an open item on magnetic-cell determination (Luttinger-Tisza step; keep, absorb into SpinState or remove CommensurateStructure) for the resumption of LSWT work. 473 passed / 0 failed. Source hashes of the D28 implementation (0e9247f) are not re-reviewed here. Revision 30 records the D28 implementation (commit 0e9247f): select_on_manifold returns the minimum of Gamma = E_cl + E_zp fitted on the 36-point relaxed soft path (soft_path_point), keeps the pure classical and quantum minima as candidates with shifts, replaces competition and not_flat by not_soft (also for classical saddles), and warns above adiabatic ratio 0.1. The implementation agrees with the independent 72-point prototype within 1.3e-3 rad in every selected case; a rerun on 2026-09-30 reproduced every verdict and value of docs/development/verification/d28-implementation-2026-09-30.json (difference 0), the 144-leaf regression snapshot matches 912bc32 exactly, and 473 tests pass. The new default zero-point provider (constrained: symmetric mesh without k = 0, no regularization) is a methodology change shown as a review request, not a decision. The tilted-field numbers of the revision 26 review record, computed with the MAGSWT-regularized provider, are corrected. Source hashes of the D28 files and the transfer contract were re-reviewed; the general-spin-model-ir hash still records the main checkout's uncommitted copy. Revision 31 records the user's decision on the D28 zero-point provider: constrained by default, and at the zone centre only the constrained orbit-rotation pair span{t, J t} (boson line u_i = sqrt(S_i)(t_theta + i t_phi)) is projected out, keeping the other zone-centre bands; the orbit axis reaches the provider through an optional keyword axis (accepts_axis), and 3-argument providers are unchanged. u, not its conjugate, is the D17 null vector of H(0) with the problem rotated off z (2e-16). Mesh dependence is mostly the discretization of the zone sum; the projection is a smaller correction (Y 1.7 degrees |shift| N = 6/12/18: 8.37e-3/8.40e-3/8.40e-3 against 8.32e-3/8.39e-3/8.39e-3 with the whole zone centre dropped) and brings the zero-tilt amplitudes closer to the N = 48 scans (J_Gamma 1.007 -> 1.0000 at N = 6). The implementation agrees with the prototype within 2.2e-3 rad; 476 tests pass and the 144-leaf snapshot is unchanged. Source hashes of the changed D28 files, the transfer contract and the new record were re-reviewed. Revision 32 records D29 (stage 5: thermal Hall as the dimensionless kappa_xy^2D/T in units of k_B^2/hbar per layer; curvature in the D13 full-position gauge; sign Omega = dA_y/dk_x - dA_x/dk_y with A = i<u|eta grad u>, anchored by physical Bloch states; the Kitaev [111]-polarized state as the reference with pairing terms; split into 5a, 5b, 5c) and stage 5a: berry_curvature from the stored diagonalization and analytic dH/dk, Chern numbers accepted only when the Kubo integral and the FHS link-variable integer agree. The particle block of H(k) for Haldane magnons equals the Bloch matrix rebuilt from ED one-magnon states within 2.7e-14 (its conjugate differs by 2); Haldane C = (+1, -1) flipping with D, Kitaev [111] C = (+1, -1) with pairing, triangular Heisenberg C = 0; band crossings between mesh points (FHS link overlap) and gap closings between mesh points (Kubo-FHS disagreement; FHS alone gives a wrong integer at D = 0 on 12 x 12) give NaN. 489 tests pass and the 144-leaf snapshot is unchanged. Source hashes of the new and changed files were re-reviewed. Revision 33 records stage 5b: thermal_hall returns kappa_xy^2D/T per layer in units of k_B^2/hbar in pair form (defined for degenerate and crossing bands; zero modes follow D25). It equals an independent two-band calculation for Haldane magnons within 3.8e-11 and the existing SI routine on the same k data within 8e-15; coplanar Heisenberg states give zero, including Neel and 120 degrees where the band sum is undefined; kappa is continuous as the Haldane gap closes. The expected convergence gain of the pair form was wrong (for separated bands it is the band sum). NBCP kappa converges slowly or erratically on uniform meshes because the curvature concentrates near small avoided crossings; this is an open item. 496 tests pass and the 144-leaf snapshot is unchanged. Source hashes of the new and changed files were re-reviewed. Revision 34 records stage 5c: the new thermal_hall and the existing SI Hall paths (Topology.compute_thermal_Hall, Thermodynamics) sum the same pair-form kernel; the existing API is kept, and its only change is that degenerate bands give a defined Hall value instead of NaN (a particle-hole pair within the cutoff still gives NaN). The four existing Hall examples agree with the previous code within 1.1e-15 and the stage-5b check within 6.7e-14; 497 tests pass and the 144-leaf snapshot is unchanged. Removal of the SI API is left to the retirement of LSWTSolver; adaptive k integration for NBCP is undecided. Source hashes of the changed files were re-reviewed. Revision 35 records stage 5d: adaptive k integration of kappa_xy/T (Richardson midpoint cells, Doerfler marking) as an optional argument of thermal_hall. For narrow Haldane gaps it matches a 2048 x 2048 two-band reference within 1e-9 to 2e-8 with 5.7e4 to 9.2e4 points; its error estimate bounds the actual error and is conservative; uniform meshes remain better for smooth integrands. For NBCP the default budget reproduces 1e6-point converged values to six digits, while the uniform 192 x 192 values of stage 5b were off by 1-4 percent (27 percent for Y J_Gamma); the integrand grows as 1/|q| at the accidental zero modes, an integrable singularity. 500 tests pass and the 144-leaf snapshot is unchanged. Source hashes of the new and changed files were re-reviewed. Revision 36 records the cleanup of superseded Working-Pad items approved on 2026-09-30: the June handoff for the general-tool transition and the code-space audit are closed as superseded by the transfer contract, the development plan and stages 0-5; the migration note points to the transfer contract; D05 is marked as implemented through D16, D20 and D23; the open item on the SI Hall API is widened to the retirement of the existing paths (LSWTSolver, EnergyFunction/SpinOptimizer, SI Hall API). No code or numerical change. Revision 37 records D30, the user's decisions on the open design items (2026-09-30): the Luttinger-Tisza step as a diagnostic tool and removal of CommensurateStructure; deprecation warnings for LSWTSolver and the SI Hall API with removal at the public-release cleanup, and retirement of EnergyFunction/SpinOptimizer after porting the global classical search; the D17 extension, later term kinds and S >= 1, and the Kitaev flux and ED 2-magnon sectors excluded from the first scope; TN field conventions after the solver-seam spike; the adaptive error estimate deferred. Implementation waits for the resumption of LSWT work. No code or numerical change.
document_purpose: Development document for implementing a 2D spin-system solver: physical information representation, required functionality and implementation methods. Document scope is distinguished from tool development goals and initial support scope; implementation and verification evidence stays in appendices.
